title: Heptagon: Decentralized Music Streaming
tagline: It is a decentralized music streaming service through NFT's and IPFS data
description: It is a prototype of a free decentralized music streaming service inspired by Spotify that uses the IPFS protocol to store music and associated graphic content. Incorporates the Lens Protocol infrastructure for the indexing and management of multimedia and its metadata and WalletConnect as a user access route
how_its_made: We have a prototype of a Free Decentralized Music Streaming Service inspired by Spotify that uses the IPFS protocol to store music and associated graphic content and incorporating the Lens Protocol infrastructure for the indexing and management of multimedia and its metadata. All of this using WalletConnect as a user access route.
